notes.title: Release 1.2.1066
notes.notes:
General update
- Enhance Meteor effect.
- Enhance Fire ball effect. 
- Increase explode range of fireball. 
- Fixed bugs in Stage 2. 
- Increase Moving Castle cool-down time to Dwarf. 

Game balancing 
- Increase Dwarf HP.
- Increase Swordsman HP. 
- Increase Butcher Boss HP. 
- Increase Demon HP. 
- Increase Fireball attack range when explode. 
- Decrease Shield soldier boss HP. 
- Decrease Tiger Fall attack range.

notes.title: Release 1.2.1062
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

The release version 1.2.1062 of Sword of the Guardian is focus on the game balancing, for more details please view the information below. Thank you for support Sword of the Guardian !!!


*General Game balancing* 

- Level up Karina AI. 
- Reduced Fafnir DEF. 
- Reduced enemies count on last stage. 
- Improved UI sound effect.


*Character balancing*

Dwarf
- Jump Strike is 2 hits now. 

Monk
- Increase Kaikyusei moving range. 
- Decrease Tetsuzankou moving range.

notes.title: Release 1.2.1059
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !!

I so glad to tell you all "Sword of the Guardian" has a big update today !! I've added more special moves to each character, more combo combinations, improved Fighting system and UI !! Hope you enjoy it !!


 Added Forward Strike and upper cut to Swordsman.
 Added Tiger Kaikyusei, Tetsuzankou and Youhou to Monk.
 Added Moving Castle, Jump Strike to Dwarf. 
 Added Command List. 
 Improved input sequence detection. 
 Improved UI. 
 Game balancing.


Cheers,
Billy Chan.

notes.title: Release 1.1.1041
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Release 1.1.1041 is a game balancing patch to improve the game experience. 

- Fixed save files issue.
- Decrease the z-axis attack range of Assassin. 
- Increase the z-axis attack range of Swordsman, Dwarf and Monk.
- Adjust the special attack range of Swordsman
